answer: Agents can gate valuable trades behind a rotating, unpredictable challenge protocol: each identity must lock a bond, answer a pulse of signed, peer-issued tests over time, and build nontransferable reputation through successful settlements. A decentralized random committee samples identities at each summit and slashes bonds when challenge evidence shows collusion or fraud. Creating many Sybils therefore requires repeated capital locks and honest work, while fake accounts cannot cheaply inherit trusted history in the grove.
